Alex Chen: quick heads-up — Lyra Labs renewal call next Wed. onboarding still flagged; I see latency spikes during batch imports last week. thinking we need a short comm + evidence pack for them. who can own the SLO credit calc? :thinking:
Priya Sharma: I can run the credit calc. short summary: 30d uptime 99.85% vs SLA 99.9% -> ~43m shortfall. ballpark credit = prorated monthly credit (TBD). I'll attach numbers.
Marta Ruiz: saw two incidents Friday 03:12 and 03:48 UTC — autoscaler thrashed during their bulk import. root cause = ephemeral queue backlog + scale-down race.
Marta Ruiz: relevant log excerpt:
```
2026-03-20T03:12:09Z autoscaler: scale_down_attempt id=af3f: active_replicas=2 desired=4 -> throttled
queue_len=1200
```
Samir Patel: ok — plan: (1) enablement session with Lyra infra + runbook review (30m) (2) short warmup schedule for daily bulk at 02:50 UTC to pre-warm caches (3) SRE fix for scale-down race (can be low-risk patch)
Samir Patel: proposed enablement slots: Tue 14:00 or Wed 09:00 PT. Which works? :calendar:
Priya Sharma: Tue 14:00 PT works for me. Alex, can you own comms to Lyra? I'll prepare the credit calc + packet.
Alex Chen: yep, will send a brief note to Lyra and share the packet. include the warmup ask and proposed session. assign SRE task to Marta. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: evidence bundle generation queued. link: https://internal.redwood/sys/evidence/4133332121 (expires in 7 days)
Marta Ruiz: I'll draft the mitigation PR and a short rollback plan. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Samir Patel: capture action items:
- Alex: customer comm + schedule (owner)
- Priya: credit calc + packet
- Marta: autoscaler fix + PR
- ops-bot: evidence bundle (done)
Alex Chen: thanks all — marking this as high renewal risk until enablement + fixes complete. I'll post an update after Tue session. :pray:
